cards.claim: The Kate Chopin House was a house in Cloutierville, Louisiana.
cards.quote: Kate Chopin House (Cloutierville, Louisiana) The Kate Chopin House, also known as the Bayou Folk Museum or Alexic Cloutier House, was a house in Cloutierville, Louisiana. It was the home of Kate Chopin, author of "The Awakening", after her marriage. The house was located on Main Street (Louisiana Highway 1) in Cloutierville, in Natchitoches Parish, Louisiana.
